scope: Mission Control integration: integrate the progress-heartbeat (d86774d) and secretless-reconciliation (b050075) candidates, add the owner-authenticated fleet-watch capability POST /api/fleet-supervisor/:projectId, then restore the AskRigor fleet watch through the control plane and resume A19-A20. findings_2026_09_24.askrigor_watch: Live /snapshot (primary daemon, 17:40Z) lists all fleet watches unfiltered: only project:human-design and project:mission-control. No AskRigor watch ever existed centrally; the earlier 'hourly watch re-enabled' checkpoint most likely referred to the external hourly fallback. The daemon mutation can only reconfigure an existing watch.
findings_2026_09_24.askrigor_project_identity: No project:askrigor (or any AskRigor project id) exists in central state; only task:askrigor-system-alignment. Watches are enrolled only by work_queue_published with nonterminal items, which AskRigor never published centrally.
findings_2026_09_24.classifier_consequence: Worker askrigor-system-alignment projects progress.outcomeAdvancement=UNKNOWN, so classifyFleetSupervisorTick returns PROJECT_INTEGRITY_FAILURE (stop + notify owner) before the WORKER_DIRECTIVE_CONTINUITY_GAP branch. An enrolled watch would therefore not route A19-A20 to mc-project-manager as the handoff expected.
findings_2026_09_24.status: Owner confirmed project id project:askrigor (2026-09-24 18:32Z) and asked to enroll it. Owner-authorized enrollment added (daemon POST /fleet-supervisor/:projectId/enroll + owner BFF route); it binds only an existing worker/task from the ledger. Enrollment itself is a live owner action, not yet performed. A standing agent-usable owner-action tool was proposed but not built: this session's safety check requires the owner's explicit approval for it.
